The v25 ZIP packaging instruction does not change the earlier task-local due-diligence assessment method, budget, coverage, or outputs.
Packaging all files as v25 does not change the required bullet appearance, level variant, or color.
The package-format and version instruction does not modify the required Tab-controlled hierarchy or resolve its workflow ambiguity.
The complete-folder and v25 delivery decision does not alter the required editable-field mechanism or handling of legacy fields.
The source changes package assembly and naming, not typography, font sizes, emphasis, or caption-text styling.
The v25 archive instruction does not change which theme colors must be included or exposed.
Packaging the files in a v25 ZIP does not modify the required table-layout behavior or resolve the existing technical conflict.
The package update does not alter field-label language, coverage, text, placement, or persistence.
The ZIP and v25 delivery instruction does not change the required paragraph, Enter-key, or line-spacing behavior.
The source package decision does not alter the approved Board Meeting row-extension workflow.
